newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Boland to buy 25.6 pct of NBS.
newsitem.headline: Boland to buy 25.6 pct of NBS.

text.p: Boland Bank Holdings Ltd announced on Tuesday it would buy approximately 25.6 percent of NBS Holdings Ltd for 1.5 billion rand.
In a statement, Boland chairman Christo Wiese said that the company had obtained the right to buy RMB Holdings Ltd's 20 percent stake of NBS at any time up until August 31 1997.
In a separate announcement, RMB Holdings said it would receive about 1.3 billion rand for the sale of its stake in NBS.
Wiese said in a separate transaction, Boland had also bought 5.6 percent or five million ordinary shares in NBS from another institutional investor which he did not name.
The transaction had been approved by the Registrar of Banks, but was still subject to approval by Boland Bank's shareholders.
Boland Bank and NBS would continue discussions on establishing a closer association and increasing their retail distribution network, Wiese said.
The acquisition was in line with Boland's stated intention to become a more significant player in the financial services market by forming alliances.

The deal would be financed partly with cash and partly through the issue of new Boland Bank ordinary shares, which RMB would then be obliged to renounce in favour of Samgro Investment Holdings Ltd -- Boland Bank's parent company -- in exchange for new Samgro shares.

As a result of this transaction Boland Bank would acquire a signficant indirect interest in RMB Holdings and Norwich Holdings South Africa, as NBS had a stake of approximately 20 and 25 percent in these companies respectively.
